PackagingVesselType.description: PackagingVesselType - a per vessel representation of a packaging process.

type.description: The kind of vessel the beer is packaged into.

description.description: Free text description of the packaging vessel.

package_date.description: The date the beer was packaged into this vessel.

start_temperature.description: The temperature of the beer at the start of the step.

end_temperature.description: The temperature of the beer at the end of the step.

step_time.description: How long the beer spends in this vessel, such as a conditioning period.

start_gravity.description: The gravity of the beer at the start of the step.

end_gravity.description: The gravity of the beer at the end of the step.

start_ph.description: The pH of the beer at the start of the step.

end_ph.description: The pH of the beer at the end of the step.

carbonation.description: The carbonation of the beer in this vessel, in volumes of CO2.

vessel_volume.description: The capacity of one vessel of this kind.

vessel_quantity.description: How many vessels of this kind were filled.

graphics.description: Artwork applied to the vessel, such as labels and cap prints.
